operations.title: Entry 1115 — The Exceptional Primitive Witness Has a Small Replicated Modular Degree Window
operations.body: At (u,v)=(0,2), a univariate polynomial-module gate for the pilot primitive has replicated modular windows (deg N,deg D)=(6,4) in the p-chart and (6,5) in the q-chart across two large primes. This bounds reconstruction but is not a characteristic-zero witness.

operations.title: The exceptional pilot primitive has a small replicated modular degree window
operations.body: The pilot module-membership problem is feasible at (6,4) in s=q/p and (6,5) in r=p/q at two independent large primes; adjacent lower windows fail.

operations.title: Two-prime exceptional polynomial-module degree gate
operations.body: Twenty-seven chart-coordinate samples were used. The result is explicitly finite-field feasibility only; exact characteristic-zero polynomial identities remain unverified.

authority_basis.summary: Continue cosmology research and record the replicated exceptional primitive degree gate
